v1-4.candidate: ‘Not so! For thus says the Lord: The bed onto which you have gone up—you will not come down from it, for there you will surely die.’ And Elijah went and spoke to them.
v1-4.close: ‘It shall not be so! For thus says the Lord: The bed onto which you have gone up—you will not come down from it, for there you will surely die.’ And Elijah went and spoke to them.

v1-6.candidate: They said to him, ‘A man came up to meet us and said to us: Come, return to the king who sent you and tell him, Thus says the Lord: Is it because there is no God in Israel that you are going to inquire of Baal Fly, the god of Ekron? Not so! The bed onto which you have gone up—you will not come down from it, for you will surely die.’

v1-16.candidate: Elijah spoke to him and said, ‘Thus says the Lord: Why did you send messengers to inquire of Baal Fly, the god of Ekron? Not so! The bed onto which you have gone up—you will not come down from it, for you will surely die.’
v1-16.close: Elijah spoke to him and said, ‘Thus says the Lord: Why did you send messengers to inquire of Baal Fly, the god of Ekron? It shall not be so! The bed onto which you have gone up—you will not come down from it, for you will surely die.’

v1-9.candidate: He sent to him a commander, a captain of fifty, with his fifty men. He went up and came to him, and behold, Elijah was sitting on the top of the mountain. The captain of fifty spoke to him and said, ‘Man of God, the king has summoned you. Come down!’
